ladder-sliding-wall.alt: A 10-foot ladder (crimson) against a wall with its foot x = 6 ft out and top y = 8 ft up, the foot sliding away at dx/dt = 2 ft/s and the top's rate dy/dt unknown; a grey ghost shows a later position. Beside it: x² + y² = 100, differentiated to 2x dx/dt + 2y dy/dt = 0, giving dy/dt = −3/2 ft/s at this instant.

ladder-sliding-question.alt: A 10-foot ladder (crimson) leaning against a wall, its foot x = 6 ft from the wall and its top y = 8 ft up. The foot slides away at dx/dt = 2 ft/s; the top's rate dy/dt is unknown. The angle θ between ladder and floor is marked; a grey ghost shows a later position.

cone-tank-question.alt: An inverted cone tank, top radius 3 ft and depth 6 ft, with water poured in at 4 ft³/min. The water is a smaller cone of depth h and surface radius r.

cone-tank-similar.alt: An inverted cone tank, top radius 3 ft and depth 6 ft, holding water of depth h and surface radius r. Similar triangles give r = h/2, so V = πh³/12 and dV/dt = (πh²/4)·dh/dt.
